about.description: ASET is an open, implementation-neutral specification for Authority-Signed Evidence Trails, enabling model-based conformance and verifiable accountability across heterogeneous sociotechnical systems.

abstract: ASET defines an open, implementation-neutral trust and accountability semantics that binds authority, context, decisions, permits, gates, transitions, evidence, verification and outcomes. Its machine canon, formal models and language-neutral conformance protocol allow independent implementations to be tested without giving any technology semantic precedence.
